title: Nnwom a Ɛkanyan Mmepɔw no
intro: Worebeyi Allah akoa bi a oye nwanwa ho asem adi. Wɔ abɔfo ne sodifo asase so no, wɔde ɔsoro nhoma, nne a ano yɛ den, ne ahoɔden a ɛboro dade so hyiraa saa onipa yi. Bere a worekenkan nsɛnkyerɛnne no, so wubetumi ahu onii ko a ebia eyi yɛ?
clues: Na meyɛ Allah akoa a wɔmaa me nwoma soronko bi.
Na mewɔ nne fɛfɛ, na na m’ayeyi no dɔ araa ma nkoko ne nnomaa mpo bɛkaa me ho.
Mihyiaa ɔsɔretiafo bi a ne ho yɛ hu wɔ ɔko bi a agye din mu, na ɛmfa ho sɛ na meyɛ ketewaa no, midii nkonim.
Wɔmaa dade yɛɛ mmerɛw maa me, na ɛmaa mitumi de m’ankasa me nsa yɛɛ akode.
Wɔyɛɛ me sodifo wɔ ɔman kɛse bi so, na m’atemmu mu nyansa gyee din.
Wɔmaa me babarima a ɔno nso yɛ odiyifo no kwan ma odi mframa ne jinn so.

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii
options: Onyaa ne ti didii mu wɔ whale no mu

arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verse: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise. (38:18)
